title: Uniformity of interpretation.
bodyText: This chapter shall be so construed as to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform the law of those states which enact it.
bodyHtml: §484-21  Uniformity of interpretation.  This chapter shall be so construed as to effectuate its general purpose to make uniform the law of those states which enact it. [L 1967, c 223, §21; HRS §484-21]
